title: FMGE Mini Test Series · FMGE Mini Test Series Year 2022 · Fmge Mini Test 17

questions.stem: A newborn infant is found to have a congenital urethral abnormality in which the urethral meatus opens on the ventral side of the penis. It is resulting in difficulty in directing the urine stream due to the ventral curvature of the penis. Which of the following is the cause of this malformation?
questions.stemHtml: A newborn infant is found to have a congenital urethral abnormality in which the urethral meatus opens on the ventral side of the penis. It is resulting in difficulty in directing the urine stream due to the ventral curvature of the penis. Which of the following is the cause of this malformation?

options.label: B
options.text: Failure of the fusion of urethral folds
